req.title: Cookies-set returns Set-Cookie per entry
req.statement: The system shall emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair passed to /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /cookies/set endpoint should emit one Set-Cookie header per key-value pair passed in the query string. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure compliance with the requirement and robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_cookies_set_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set with two key-value pairs in the query string.
expected: Two Set-Cookie headers are present in the response.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2')
assert response.status_code == 200
set_cookie_headers = [header for header in response.headers if header == 'Set-Cookie']
assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2

tests.name: test_cookies_set_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set with an invalid query string.
expected: The response status code is 400 or 500 indicating a client or server error.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set?invalid')
assert response.status_code in [400, 500]

tests.name: test_cookies_set_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set with a single key-value pair in the query string.
expected: One Set-Cookie header is present in the response.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1')
assert response.status_code == 200
set_cookie_headers = [header for header in response.headers if header == 'Set-Cookie']
assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 1
